appName: Gas N Chaos: Winter Cars Update
displayName: Gas N Chaos: Winter Cars Update
display_name: Gas N Chaos: Winter Cars Update
display_long_description:
# Winter hits the messiest Gas Station in VR! ❄️⛽

Snow is falling, roads are frozen and every car rolling in is a mess. Keep drivers moving through the storm, or turn your lot into an ice rink of chaos.

**⛽ Fuel Frozen Cars**

Fill tanks, take payment and keep the queue moving. Fast service means bigger tips, or spill fuel on the ice and watch cars spin out.


**🧊 Scrape, De-Ice & Shovel**

Brush snow off roofs, scrape icy windshields and clear the lot, or leave it buried and see who gets stuck.


**🔧 Winter-Proof & Repair**

Jump-start dead batteries, fit snow chains and top up antifreeze. Quality work builds your reputation.


**💥 Wreck, Slide & Go Wild**

Rip off parts, smash frosty windows and start snowball fights with drivers.


**🚚 Keep Your Tanks Full**

Fuel drains fast in winter. Call the fuel truck and pay from your earnings. No fuel, no customers, no money.


**📦 Unlock Winter Gear**

Spend your earnings on shovels, heaters, upgrades and new tools.


**🚔 Catch Wanted Drivers**

Spot drivers on the sheriff's list before they skid away and cash in the bounty.


Snowy chaos, slippery physics, and a winter station that's yours to run… or ruin. ❄️
